responsibility: This file implements a small RTL analysis pass that determines whether the stack pointer remains unchanged throughout a function before prologue/epilogue emission. It scans stores and autoincrement/autodecrement memory uses for direct or implicit modifications of stack_pointer_rtx, sets crtl->sp_is_unchanging accordingly, and updates exit-block uses in dataflow when the result is positive. Its responsibility is to provide a backend-wide fact used by targets that can simplify epilogues when the stack pointer was never adjusted.
